overall_summary: The channel shows a clear distinction between relationship/self-respect digital micro-dramas (averaging 10-25 views, heavily reliant on niche phone/digital actions like chat deletions) and family/universal emotional shorts (Maa, Papa, general life check-ins like 'Call a loved one') which significantly outperformed the baseline with 90 to 270 views. However, sample sizes are small, so confidence remains low.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about Mother ('Maa'), Father ('Papa'), and calling a loved one ('आज किसी अपने को Call कर लेना') achieved 132 to 270 views, vastly outperforming hyper-specific digital clean-up shorts.
winning_patterns.action: Broaden the emotional scope slightly beyond niche phone-deleting mechanics to include universally relatable life moments.

weak_patterns.evidence: Repeatedly using micro-actions like un-pinning chats, clearing keyboard names, and removing shared albums (e.g., videos like HMyw6blmGOc and cuKSS0gHyt0) hit a ceiling of 0-2 views due to repetitiveness.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid repeating identical phone-screen delete formats back-to-back; introduce fresh real-life objects or scenarios.
